d:
Royal Desert Champions roar back with a commanding 6-wicket win over UAE Bulls!
Batting first, UAE Bulls posted 123/7 in 10 overs, with Khawaja Nafay (27 off 11) and Kieron Pollard (23 off 10) providing quickfire contributions.
In reply, Royal Desert Champions chased down the target in just 9.1 overs, reaching 124/4 with 5 balls to spare. Sherfane Rutherford led the charge with a blistering 40 off just 13 balls to seal RDC’s first win of the tournament!
